quote: We have observed that mice deficient for Tlr2 or Il1r do not show a differential susceptibility to colitis or CAC.
summary: Mice lacking Il1r showed no difference in susceptibility to AOM/DSS colitis or colitis-associated cancer, unlike Il18 and Il18r1 knockouts.
The paper is about the IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL1RN, IL-1Ra), not the IL1R1 receptor.

quote: Transfer of Il1r1-/- CD4+ T cells into Rag1-/-/Il10rb-/- mice reduced the severity of their colitis (compared to mice that received CD4+ T cells that express IL1R), accompanied by decreased production of interferon gamma, tumor necrosis factor-α, and IL17A.
summary: Il1r1-deficient CD4+ T cells caused milder colitis in Il10rb-deficient mice, and the IL-1 receptor antagonist anakinra helped two IL10R-deficient IBD patients.

quote: We have identified latency-associated peptide (LAP) and IL-1 receptor type I and II (CD121a/CD121b) as unique cell-surface markers that distinguish activated Tregs from activated FOXP3(-) and FOXP3(+) non-Tregs.
summary: IL-1 receptor type I (CD121a) is selectively expressed on activated human FOXP3+ Tregs and can be used to purify them.
The paper is about IL-1 receptor antagonist isoforms (IL1RN), not the IL1R1 receptor.

quote: In some malignancies, dysregulation of inflammatory toll-like receptor (TLR) and interleukin-1 receptor (IL1R) signalling is typified by increased NF-κB activity, and it occurs through somatic mutations, chromosomal deletions, and/or transcriptional deregulation.
summary: Cancer review of IRAK kinases that mentions IL1R signalling in passing; no UC data on IL1R1.

quote: In the current study of Behçet disease (BD), nonsynonymous variants (NSVs) identified by deep exonic resequencing of 10 genes found by GWAS (IL10, IL23R, CCR1, STAT4, KLRK1, KLRC1, KLRC2, KLRC3, KLRC4, and ERAP1) and 11 genes selected for their role in innate immunity (IL1B, IL1R1, IL1RN, NLRP3, MEFV, TNFRSF1A, PSTPIP1, CASP1, PYCARD, NOD2, and TLR4) were evaluated for BD association.
summary: IL1R1 was one of 21 genes resequenced in Behçet disease; only IL23R, TLR4, MEFV and NOD2 were reported as associated.

quote: The IMF-mediated mechanism we propose also involves the IBD-associated genes IL1R1, MAPK1, and the PGE2 receptor-encoding PTGER4.
summary: IL1R1 is named as an IBD-associated gene in a proposed Tpl2 myofibroblast mechanism, with no specific result about it.

quote: HS T17 cells expressed lower levels of IL23R and higher levels of IL1R1 and IL17F compared to psoriasis T17 cells
summary: In skin single-cell data, hidradenitis T17 cells express more IL1R1 than psoriasis T17 cells; this is not a gut or UC study.
The paper measures IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL1ra) in rheumatoid arthritis, not the IL1R1 receptor.
Despite IL1R1 in the title, the abstract tests IL-33 and IL1RL1 (ST2) polymorphisms, not IL1R1.

quote: miR-148a directly targets several well-accepted upstream regulators of NF-κB and STAT3 signaling, including GP130, IKKα, IKKβ, IL1R1 and TNFR2, which leads to decreased NF-κB and STAT3 activation in macrophages and colon tissues.
summary: IL1R1 is one of several miR-148a targets; the paper tests miR-148a loss in colitis, not IL1R1 itself.
The paper concerns IL-1 receptor antagonist (Il1rn) deficiency and arthritis, not IL1R1.
The paper measures circulating IL-1 receptor antagonist (IL1Ra) in pregnancy and rheumatic disease, not IL1R1.
The paper is about IL-36 receptor antibodies; IL1R family is mentioned only as a family name, not IL1R1.

quote: The potential contribution of the IL1R-TLR-IRAK-NF-κBs signaling molecules and NLR/inflammasomes in prostate pathologies, as well as the prospective benefits of selectively targeting the midstream molecules in the various inflammatory cascades, are also discussed.
summary: Prostate disease review that discusses IL1R signalling generally; no gut or UC data on IL1R1.

quote: Mice deficient in IL-1RI signaling showed reduced expression of IL-10 and type I IFN and increased susceptibility to dextran sulphate sodium-induced colitis and failed to mount a protective type I IFN response after TLR9 ligand (CpG) administration.
summary: Il1r1-deficient mice had reduced IL-10 and type I IFN and were more susceptible to DSS colitis, so IL-1R1 signalling limited colitis here.
The paper measures plasma IL1ra (receptor antagonist) as a diabetes marker, not IL1R1.

quote: Together, our data show that IL1R1-signaling triggers enteric gliosis, which results in ME-Mac activation and the development of POI.
summary: Enteric glia-specific IL1R1 deletion prevented gliosis, immune infiltration and postoperative ileus in mice, a surgical gut inflammation model rather than colitis.

quote: Specifically, we found that let-7 miRNAs may directly target the cytokine receptors Il1r1 and Il23r, as well as the chemokine receptors Ccr2 and Ccr5.
summary: Il1r1 is named as one of several let-7 targets in Th17 cells in a multiple sclerosis mouse model.

quote: Amongst these are IL6, its receptor and co-receptor,  IL1R , TNF response pathways, and complement genes.
summary: IL1R is listed among genes in a program shared by ACE2+TMPRSS2+ cells in a SARS-CoV-2 single-cell atlas.

quote: Disulfide HMGB1 activates the TLR4 complex by binding to MD-2.
summary: Review of HMGB1 as an inflammatory target noting that it activates TLR4 by binding MD-2 (LY96), without new data.

quote: We conclude that IEC limit dysregulated LPS signaling by down-regulating expression of MD-2 and TLR4.
summary: Intestinal epithelial cells lack MD-2; co-expressing MD-2 with TLR4 restored LPS-induced NF-kappaB and IL-8 reporter activation, so low MD-2 limits epithelial inflammation.

quote: TLR4/MD-2 and CD14 were localized at crypt bottom epithelial cells.
summary: TLR4/MD-2 protein localised to crypt-bottom epithelial cells and mononuclear cells in the mouse colon; TLR4 and related genes rose in DSS colitis.

quote: IFN-gamma regulates MD-2 expression in both IEC lines, whereas IFN-gamma and TNF-alpha regulate TLR4 mRNA expression in IEC lines.
summary: Human intestinal epithelial cells express little MD-2, and IFN-gamma raises MD-2 promoter activity and expression, sensitizing the cells to LPS.
